sources.title: A Fairer Gradient Step — The Muon Optimizer — A Visual Walkthrough
sources.snippet: The scale question was settled by Moonshot AI. Their "Muon is Scalable" study found that with just two adjustments — adding weight decay and carefully tuning the per-parameter update size — Muon delivered roughly 2× the compute efficiency of AdamW on compute-optimal training, and trained their Moonlight mixture-of-experts model out of the box.

sources.title: [2505.02222] Practical Efficiency of Muon for Pretraining
sources.snippet: We demonstrate that Muon, the simplest instantiation of a second-order optimizer, explicitly expands the Pareto frontier over AdamW on the compute-time tradeoff. We find that Muon is more effective than AdamW in retaining data efficiency at large batch sizes, far beyond the so-called critical batch size, while remaining computationally efficient, thus enabling more economical training. sources.title: Muon Optimizer Achieves 2× Speed Over AdamW in Production LLM Training
sources.snippet: Muon, an optimizer designed for large-language-model training, achieves roughly 2× computational efficiency compared to AdamW at compute-optimal scale. This is the headline finding from a new arXiv survey by Aditya Ranganath, published May 9, 2026: "Navigating LLM Valley: From AdamW to Memory-Efficient and Matrix-Based Optimizers."
